bug_semantics: CWE-918 SSRF in agent/component/invoke.py: Invoke builds an outbound URL from canvas configuration (later also runtime template variables) and issues requests.get/post/put without assert_url_is_safe or DNS pinning; the response body is returned as component output, so a user who can create or trigger an agent can reach loopback, link-local, RFC1918, and cloud-metadata destinations.
flaw_origin: adb0a93d955ca5d6117c871a77d0c3eadb02fa6b (add component invoke #2967, 2024-10-22) first added agent/component/invoke.py. It stripped self._param.url, prefixed http:// when the scheme was missing, and called requests.get/put with that URL and no SSRF validator. Parent 226bdd6e99397931f58e7baf230954c71a27aaa5 has no invoke.py and no equivalent unguarded Invoke fetch. Later 66d0d44a0004bbbc9b57426acd0520205b0bf7ee interpolated {variables} into the URL and d053317c4d85657d2bc6dd37e5a08371afb4be6d extracted _build_url/_send_request; both reused the same unguarded sink. fb95136f391fac8fa4288d4f687e473675c3cdb2 (crawler SSRF fix) only restyled invoke.py and did not add a guard.
